metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred focuses on ABP identification, achieving an Accuracy of 87.6% and an MCC of 0.742.

metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred achieved an average GMean at 82.8% in identifying ABPs targeting 10 bacterial species.

metrics.usage: Pearson correlation coefficient for activity level prediction in AMPActiPred
metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred demonstrates robust predictive capabilities for ABP activity levels with an average PCC of 0.722.

important_evidence: AntiBP3: machine learning model using amino acid binary profile of terminal residues achieved max AUC 0.93 (GP), 0.98 (GN), 0.94 (GV); MCC 0.75 for GP. Web server, standalone, pip package provided.

AMPActiPred: three-stage deep forest framework for ABP identification, species-specific activity prediction, and activity level prediction; Accuracy 87.6%, MCC 0.742 (Stage 1); average GMean 82.8% (10 species); average PCC 0.722 (activity levels).
APEX mentioned in review as a model capable of species-specific antibacterial activity prediction (Level 3/4); original paper Wan, Torres, et al. 2024 needs full-text verification.
uncertainties: APEX model details (architecture, code, dataset) need full-text verification of the original paper (Wan, Torres, et al. 2024).
Are the training datasets of AntiBP3 and AMPActiPred publicly available? Current evidence does not provide download links.
Does AMPActiPred have a code repository beyond the web server?

The review mentions many other models (e.g., Martínez-Mauricio et al. 2024, Li et al. 2022, Shao et al. 2024) without explicit model names; these may be relevant for future inclusion after full-text review.
